## Architecture Overview

The Config interface with `Validate() error` is used by every OTel Collector component. Replacing it with `ValidateWithContext(ctx context.Context) error` requires updating every component config across the entire OTel ecosystem including core, contrib, Jaeger, and Tempo.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Collector Configs with Validate()

- **`exporter/otlpexporter/config.go`** — OTLP exporter validates non-empty endpoint.
- **`receiver/otlpreceiver/config.go`** — OTLP receiver validates at least one protocol.
- **`processor/batchprocessor/config.go`** — Batch processor validates batch size and metadata keys.
- **`exporter/debugexporter/config.go`** — Debug exporter validates verbosity levels.
- **`service/telemetry/otelconftelemetry/config.go`** — Service telemetry validates metrics reader requirements.
- **`service/pipelines/config.go`** — Pipeline config validates at least one receiver and exporter.
- **`filter/config.go`** — Filter config validates mutual exclusivity and regex patterns.
- **`config/configtls/configtls.go`** — TLS configuration validation.

### Contrib Configs with Validate()

- **`exporter/kafkaexporter/config.go`** — Kafka exporter validates partition strategy.
- **`pkg/datadog/config/config.go`** — Datadog config validates API keys and metadata.
- **`receiver/kafkareceiver/config.go`** — Kafka receiver validates settings.
- **`exporter/logicmonitorexporter/config.go`** — LogicMonitor validates API token and endpoint.

### Jaeger Configs

- **`jaeger/internal/storage/cassandra/config/config.go`** — Cassandra storage validates connection settings.
- **`jaeger/internal/storage/elasticsearch/config/config.go`** — Elasticsearch validates index options.

### Tempo Configs

- **`tempo/pkg/ingest/config.go`** — Ingest config validates consumer lag and SASL credentials.
